privacy.imageInput: stdin only; no image files or external inference requests
privacy.modelLoading: local verified model only; no runtime download
privacy.networkPolicy: Deployment must deny outbound traffic for the dedicated Python executable.
privacy.runtimeUpgrade: Worker rejects any MediaPipe version other than 0.10.32. Re-evaluate network behavior before upgrading.

limitations: Predictions are approximate; low-visibility, absent and out-of-frame landmarks must remain unavailable.
No neck center, head center, hidden landmarks or RULA scores are synthesized by the worker.
Multiple detected people require subject selection or abstention by the caller.
This model is not intended for life-critical decisions; assessment results require human review.
